name: frigade-engage
description: Build and manage Frigade Engage onboarding flows and collections, with React and Next.js integration.

interface.longDescription:
Build product onboarding with Frigade Engage directly from ChatGPT or Codex. Create announcements, guided product tours, onboarding checklists, forms, surveys, banners, cards, NPS surveys, and flow collections. Manage flow content, targeting, publishing, versions, and promotion from development to production.

Includes 23 workflow recipes, 10 technical references, and 7 YAML examples, with instructions for integrating @frigade/react into React and Next.js applications.

This is a skills-only plugin. Executing workspace operations requires a Frigade account, API credentials configured securely in your project, and an execution environment with access to your application files and the Frigade API. In chat-only environments, it can prepare drafts and implementation guidance. It defaults to development, preserves production and destructive-operation safeguards, and keeps private API keys out of client-side application code.

Based on the FrigadeHQ/frigade-engage-skill repository and adapted for ChatGPT and Codex.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me build product onboarding with Frigade Engage in my React or Next.js project.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission of Frigade Engage. Packages 23 recipes, 10 references, and 7 YAML examples with ChatGPT/Codex execution guidance, secure credential handling, React/Next.js integration, and development-to-production promotion safeguards. Adds Frigade branding and public listing links. No MCP server or payment flow is included.
